Customer ReviewATIVAFIT 5 to 25LB Adjustable Dumbbell Set of 2[See Full Review](#)

Product Description

Upgrade your strength training routine with the ATIVAFIT 5-in-1 Adjustable Dumbbell Set, designed for efficient home workouts and space-saving convenience. This 25 LB pair replaces multiple free weights in one compact system, making it ideal for apartments, dorm rooms, and home gyms. Featuring 5 weight settings (5, 10, 15, 20, 25 LB per dumbbell), this adjustable dumbbell set supports progressive overload for beginners and light-to-moderate strength training. Easily switch between exercises using the quick dial adjustment system without removing plates. The precision-machined alloy steel handle delivers a secure, anti-slip grip for improved control during curls, presses, rows, and other free weight exercises. An integrated safety lock system ensures plates remain firmly secured before lifting. Perfect for full-body workouts, muscle toning, endurance training, and daily fitness routines.

Product Description

Upgrade your strength training routine with the ATIVAFIT 5-in-1 Adjustable Dumbbell Set, designed for efficient home workouts and space-saving convenience. This 25 LB pair replaces multiple free weights in one compact system, making it ideal for apartments, dorm rooms, and home gyms. Featuring 5 weight settings (5, 10, 15, 20, 25 LB per dumbbell), this adjustable dumbbell set supports progressive overload for beginners and light-to-moderate strength training. Easily switch between exercises using the quick dial adjustment system without removing plates. The precision-machined alloy steel handle delivers a secure, anti-slip grip for improved control during curls, presses, rows, and other free weight exercises. An integrated safety lock system ensures plates remain firmly secured before lifting. Perfect for full-body workouts, muscle toning, endurance training, and daily fitness routines.
